xBRIEFInfo.description: Project definition for the fictional Northstar testing and gates lab

narratives.Overview: A fictional disposable no-remote repository for one ordered red-green-refactor cycle and aggregate-gate diagnosis.
narratives.Product: A tiny numeric summary module used only to make focused, literal, forward-coverage, and aggregate evidence observable.
narratives.SourceOfTruth: The active xBRIEF owns the three-file work scope; retained stage evidence lives outside the repository.
narratives.DevelopmentPosture: Private pre-release training fixture with no compatibility layer.
narratives.ProjectRules: Use fictional data only. Keep every mutation inside the unique operating-system temporary repository. Change the focused test only before red evidence, change the source only between red and refactor evidence, and change the quality record only after the seeded aggregate failure. Never change a gate definition. Do not add a remote, push, open a pull request, merge, deploy, publish, or release.
